We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the account referenced above. We understand that you have requested validation of the debt and have questioned the legitimacy of our agency's involvement in the collection of this debt.

This notice will include the amount of the debt, the name of the original creditor, and a statement indicating that unless you dispute the debt within 30 days, we will assume the debt to be valid.

We confirm that the original creditor for this account was Lakeshore Utilities. The current balance of the account is $4,924.62. The charge-off date for this account was March 8, 2021, and the last payment date was June 16, 2021.

We will provide you with a written validation notice as required by law. We will also investigate your dispute regarding our agency's involvement in the collection of this debt.

Please note that you have the right to dispute this debt further if you believe that the information provided is inaccurate or incomplete. If you wish to dispute the debt, please respond to this letter within 30 days.
